description:
Get details for a specific Bitcoin Rune by its name or numeric ID.

Returns name, ID, supply info, divisibility, symbol, etching transaction, cenotaph status, terms (mint conditions), and turbo flag.

Rune names use spacers (e.g., 'UNCOMMONGOODS' or 'UNCOMMON•GOODS').

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

rune.description: Rune name (e.g., 'UNCOMMONGOODS' or 'UNCOMMON•GOODS') or numeric rune ID

name: runes_get_etching
